arguments.command:
python << 'EOF'
import re

with open('src/humanize/time.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Add typing import after datetime
content = re.sub(
    r'^import datetime as dt$',
    'import datetime as dt\nfrom typing import Any, Optional, Union, Callable',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update naturaldelta - it's multi-line so let's be careful
content = re.sub(
    r'^def naturaldelta\(\n    value,\n    months=True,\n    minimum_unit="seconds",\n    when=None,\n\) -> str:',
    '''def naturaldelta(
    value: Union[dt.timedelta, int, float],
    months: bool = True,
    minimum_unit: str = "seconds",
    when: Optional[dt.datetime] = None,
) -> str:''',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update naturaltime
content = re.sub(
    r'^def naturaltime\(\n    value,\n    future=False,\n    months=True,\n    minimum_unit="seconds",\n    when=None,\n\) -> str:',
    '''def naturaltime(
    value: Union[dt.datetime, int, float],
    future: bool = False,
    months: bool = True,
    minimum_unit: str = "seconds",
    when: Optional[dt.datetime] = None,
) -> str:''',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update naturalday
content = re.sub(
    r'^def naturalday\(value, format="%b %d"\) -> str:',
    'def naturalday(value: object, format: str = "%b %d") -> str:',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update naturaldate
content = re.sub(
    r'^def naturaldate\(value\) -> str:',
    'def naturaldate(value: object) -> str:',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Update precisedelta
content = re.sub(
    r'^def precisedelta\(value, minimum_unit="seconds", suppress=\(\), format="%0\.2f"\) -> str:',
    '''def precisedelta(
    value: Union[int, float, dt.timedelta],
    minimum_unit: str = "seconds",
    suppress: tuple = (),
    format: str = "%0.2f",
) -> str:''',
    content,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

with open('src/humanize/time.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Updated time.py")
EOF
